# ex: strict wildcard binding in bindWildcard
ex {
	var x int
	strict x
	x + 0 -> x
}
-- x.go --
package m

func F() int {
	var x int = 1
	var y int32 = 2
	_ = y + 0
	return x + 0
}
-- stdout --
diff old/x.go new/x.go
--- old/x.go
+++ new/x.go
@@ -4,5 +4,5 @@
 	var x int = 1
 	var y int32 = 2
 	_ = y + 0
-	return x + 0
+	return x
 }
